- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v1 c15 P40](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0040), [v1 c15 P41](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0041)</sub>
- **Status:** Alive  <sub>[v2 c12 P32](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0032)</sub>
- **Rank:** Student  <sub>[v1 c15 P40](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0040), [v1 c27 P4](../source/v01-c27.md#nw-v01-c27-p0004)</sub>
- **Origin:** Brierley  <sub>[v1 c15 P40](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0040), [v2 c1 P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045)</sub>

## Appearance

Anthony has a dark, gloomy small face and black eyes.

_Sources: [v2 c5 P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004), [v2 c12 P28](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0028)_

## Personality

Anthony is a clever, cheeky, and independent boy who refuses to follow the crowd. He holds a strong bias against female teachers and behaves with an impertinent, sullen, or disdainful air toward authority. Despite his oppositional nature, he respects strength and fairness, eventually coming to respect his teacher Nell Harcourt after she physically punishes him for misbehavior.

_Sources: [v1 c27 P4](../source/v01-c27.md#nw-v01-c27-p0004), [v1 c27 P19](../source/v01-c27.md#nw-v01-c27-p0019), [v2 c1 P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045), [v2 c5 P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004), [v2 c5 P10](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0010), [v2 c12 P28](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0028), [v2 c12 P50](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0050), [v2 c12 P52](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0052)_

## History

Anthony Tulk is a student at Brierley school. When Nell Harcourt becomes his teacher, he openly shows disdain for her and refuses to show her respect, maintaining that female teachers are useless. On one occasion, he empties his slate water bottle down Aurelia Clay's neck, for which Nell detains him after class to lecture him on how gentlemen ought to behave. His attitude toward her remains sullen and defiant. Later, he puts a live mouse into Nell's desk drawer; when Nell discovers it and asks who is responsible, Anthony insolently admits to the prank. Outraged by his insolence, Nell gives him a thrashing with a pointer. Following this punishment, Anthony's attitude toward Nell changes completely; he develops a deep respect for her, acknowledging that her whipping was as effective as a man's, and begins offering to carry her books to school.

_Sources: [v1 c18 P10](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0010), [v2 c1 P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045), [v2 c5 P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004), [v2 c5 P10](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0010), [v2 c12 P23](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0023), [v2 c12 P28](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0028), [v2 c12 P29](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0029), [v2 c12 P33](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0033), [v2 c12 P48](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0048), [v2 c12 P49](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0049), [v2 c12 P50](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0050), [v2 c12 P52](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0052)_
